segments.text:
V. 77.
To give knowledge of ſalvation, by the remiſſion of ſins—The Knowledge of the Remiſſion of our Sins, being the grand Inſtrument of preſent and eternal Salvation, Heb. viii. 11, 12. But the immediate Senſe of the Words ſeems to be, To preach to them the Goſpel Doctrine of Salvation by the Remiſſion of their Sins.
